3. **Skill & Tech Stack Auditing**: Verifying technical skills (TypeScript, Next.js 16, React 19, Python, PyTorch, LangChain, Supabase, Tailwind CSS).

## Featured Projects Index

### 1. Late-Meet — AI Meeting Copilot
- **Description**: Local-first Chrome extension using speech transcription & lightweight LLMs to summarize meetings in real-time.
- **Problem**: Online meetings cause note-taking cognitive overload.
- **Solution**: Audio stream VAD filtering, real-time transcription, on-device summarization with zero server cost.
- **Tech Stack**: TypeScript, Chrome Extensions API, VAD, OpenAI.
- **URL**: https://github.com/shouri123/Late-Meet

### 2. Aven — Multi-Agent Multi-Window Platform
- **Description**: Split-pane multi-agent platform for executing parallel AI reasoning workflows.
- **Problem**: Single-chat AI flows bottleneck complex multi-step tasks.
- **Solution**: Multi-window architecture managing dynamic agent state sync across panes.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, TypeScript, Vercel, Multi-Agent Architecture.
- **URL**: https://aven-seven.vercel.app

### 3. Chat-Buddy — WhatsApp AI Agent
- **Description**: Stateful WhatsApp agent built with OpenAI Agents SDK.
- **Tech Stack**: Python, OpenAI SDK, WhatsApp API.
- **URL**: https://www.npmjs.com/package/chat-buddy

### 4. Java-Tut — Interactive OOP Learning Hub
- **Description**: Cinematic portal for Java object-oriented design pattern tutorials.
- **URL**: https://java-tut.vercel.app/

### 5. Student-Copilot — Academic Notes Vector Indexer
- **Description**: AI assistant transforming lecture recordings into vector embeddings and custom study guides.
- **URL**: https://github.com/shouri123/Student-Copilot
